_read_me: Workflow: release-notes drafter (trace run-c-bloated). Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. EVERY value below is a sample or a placeholder. Replace what you can source and write the source in roi-worksheet.md.

before._runs: ASSUMPTION: runs per month. Sample data has only 24 runs.
before._acceptance_rate: SAMPLE: python -m tracelab.decisions data/reviewer-decisions.csv (accepted + edited, of 24)
before._tokens: SAMPLE: traces/run-c-bloated.json, sum over its 3 model calls
before._price: PLACEHOLDER: currency per million tokens. Not any model's real price. Use your contract or billing export.
before._review_min_per_run: SAMPLE: reviewer-decisions.csv, mean review_min over ALL runs, including rejected ones
before._edit_min_per_accepted: SAMPLE: reviewer-decisions.csv, edit minutes summed over kept outputs / kept outputs
before._rework_per_accepted: ASSUMPTION: 0.11 later defects per kept output (sample) x 30 min to fix at the hourly rate
before._hourly_rate: PLACEHOLDER: loaded cost of an engineer-hour
before._manual_min_per_task: PLACEHOLDER: minutes to write the release notes by hand. The deck wants a measured baseline, not a guess.

after._assumption: ASSUMPTION to check: acceptance, review time and edit time do not change after the fix.
